data.name: Muraad
data.gender_notes: Muraad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who aspires or desires. The name Muraad carries the meaning “Desire, Wish” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Muraad usually hope their child will grow to embody desire, wish and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the deepest longing of one's soul
data.etymology: Muraad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Desire, Wish.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muraad total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: موراد
in_arabic.long_meaning: المُرَادُ: المطلوب من الله تعالى; المطلوب من الله، وهو المراد من الله في كل أمر، ومعناه أن الله قد اختار ذلك المطلوب، وقرره، ورضاه به، كما قال تعالى: (وَأَنَّا لَمَسحنا بِالرُّوعِ لِأَنبَإِ مُوسى لِقَومِهِ نُرِي بِمِنَ اللَّيْلِ لَهُمْ نُورٌ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَرِجالٌ يَقُصُّونَ قِصَصًا عَنْ بَعدِ الْهِجْرَةِ وَكِتَابٌ مُقْطَعٌ) [المدثر: 4]

in_urdu.name: موراد
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ کی مرضی، اللہ کا مطلوب
in_urdu.long_meaning: موراد کا مطلب اللہ کی مرضی ہے، جسے اللہ نے چاہا ہو، اس کی رضا ہے۔ کہا جاتا ہے کہ اللہ تعالیٰ نے انسداد پر نجات دلانے کے لیے یہ نام اپنایا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुराद
in_hindi.meaning: अल्लाह की इच्छा, अल्लाह का चाहिए
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुराद का अर्थ है अल्लाह की मर्जी, जो अल्लाह की मर्जी है, उसी की मर्जी، और जो अल्लाह ने चाहा हो، उसी की मर्जी۔

in_pashto.name: موراد
in_pashto.long_meaning: موراد دا معنا دا لوی دي دې، په همدې معني دې چې دا نوم الله تعالى څخه اخیستل شوی دی.

in_english.name: Muraad
in_english.meaning: Allah's will, Allah's intention, chosen by Allah
in_english.long_meaning: Muraad is an Arabic name that means Allah's will, Allah's intention, and the one chosen by Allah. The name is derived from the Arabic root 'r-w-d' meaning to be desired or to be chosen. In Islamic theology, Muraad refers to the will of Allah and the intention of Allah. It is a name that symbolizes the obedience to Allah's will and the surrender to Allah's decree. In Islamic tradition, Muraad is a name associated with wisdom, intelligence, and spiritual growth.

data.cultural_impact: The Islamic name Muraad carries a deep cultural significance as it reflects the human desire and longing for something that brings joy, fulfillment, and purpose to one's life. This desire can be for personal achievements, spiritual growth, or the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom. In Islamic culture, the concept of aspiration and striving for excellence is highly valued, and the name Muraad embodies this spirit of motivation and determination.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Muraad can be seen as representing the yearning of the soul for love, connection, and closeness to the Divine. In Sufi teachings, the mystic journey towards oneness with God is often described as a process of fulfilling the deepest longings and desires of the self. Therefore, the name Muraad can be a reminder of our innate spiritual yearning for the Beloved, and the importance of nurturing this longing through prayer, meditation, and good deeds.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Desire, Wish" symbolizes One who aspires or desires. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Muraad serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of desire, wish.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Muraad was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and is mentioned in various hadiths. The name Muraad carried significant weight in that era.
